narrative.headline: Top 50 tape is decisively risk-on — 30 of 50 names bullish/lean bullish with heavy institutional accumulation in defensives, financials, and select mega-cap tech.
bullish_setups: V: perfect 10.0 composite — flow 10.0 with $2.7M call premium + $287M dark pool + max block conviction
PG: full 10.0 across all three components + $338M dark pool — staples accumulation
GOOG: 9.89 score, $11.5M flow premium, ~$930M dark pool — largest mega-cap tech conviction print
AMZN: flow 8.54 on $33.9M call premium + $818M dark pool — size-weighted standout
AMD: flow 8.35 on $33.7M call premium + $954M dark pool — semis being aggressively bid
CAT: $1.26B dark pool print with flow 7.58 — largest single dark pool magnitude on the board
UNH / JNJ / MRK: healthcare trifecta all bullish with $490M+ dark pool support in JNJ
GS / BAC: financials bid with flow 8.3–8.9 and $280M+ dark pool each
XOM: flow 8.83, $397M dark pool — energy participating
KLAC / CSCO: secondary tech accumulation, both 8.5+ composites
bearish_setups: AAPL: flow 4.1 despite max dark pool/blocks — put-heavy structural positioning is the tell; institutions hedging the biggest weight
META: flow 2.88 is the weakest mega-cap tech read — clear divergence from GOOG/AMZN
COST: flow 2.64 — put premium dominant despite max dark pool conviction
PLTR: flow 3.57 — high-beta name being faded
C / MS / AXP: financial-sector split — GS/BAC bid while C, MS, AXP see put flow (flow 3.2–3.5)
ABBV / KO / PM: defensive laggards — put flow diverges from broader staples/healthcare bid
AAPL and META together represent meaningful index-weight bearish pressure
narrative.rotation_signal: Accumulation is broad but selective within sectors: GOOG/AMZN/AMD bid while AAPL/META faded; GS/BAC bid while C/MS/AXP faded; PG/JNJ/MRK bid while KO/ABBV/PM faded. This is stock-picking rotation, not blanket risk-on — smart money is upgrading quality within each sector rather than chasing beta.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: AAPL is the key divergence — max dark pool and block conviction (10.0/10.0) but flow only 4.1, suggesting large prints may be distribution rather than accumulation. META shows similar pattern (flow 2.88 vs 10.0 dark pool). Financials split (GS/BAC bullish, C/MS bearish) may conflict with a monolithic sector read.
